apple.name: Odd Bloom
apple.subtitle: Find the different bloom
apple.description: Find the one original flower whose structure differs from the others. Boards grow from 6 to 16 flowers across twelve deterministic rounds. Tap to choose, revisit earlier rounds, replay a pattern, and save progress on this device. There is no timer, score penalty, or forced streak.
